data.name: Ekant
data.gender_notes: Ekant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ekant means Solitary or One. It is a name that signifies being alone, secluded or detached for spiritual growth and introspection. The name Ekant carries the meaning “Solitary, One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekant usually hope their child will grow to embody solitary, one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking solitude and inner peace.
data.etymology: Ekant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Solitary, One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ekant total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
